Pixel-perfect Webflow → Next.js port for 2 routes in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

Routes to fix:
1. /pricing  →  src/app/pricing/page.tsx + src/components/pricing/*
2. /our-works  →  src/app/our-works/page.tsx + src/components/our-works/*

GOAL: Make these pages match `https://boldteq.com/pricing` and `https://boldteq.com/our-works` 100% — every section, padding, font-size, color, image, breakpoint must match Webflow source `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/pricing.html` and `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-works.html`. Production-grade.

WORKFLOW PER PAGE:

A. Read the Webflow source HTML for the page in full.
B. Read the current local Next.js implementation (page.tsx + all components in section folder).
C. Identify:
   - Section render order — must match Webflow exactly
   - Missing sections (add them)
   - Extra sections not in Webflow (remove them)
   - Section CSS values that diverge from Webflow source CSS
D. For each Webflow class used in the page, grep `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` to find ALL rules including @media variants:
   - Default
   - @media (min-width: 1280px)  (line 21619)
   - @media (min-width: 1440px)  (line 23146)
   - @media (max-width: 991px)   (line 24454)
   - @media (max-width: 767px)   (line 26907)
   - @media (max-width: 479px)   (line 29202)
E. Edit local CSS modules to match Webflow values verbatim. Use `display: grid` not Tailwind. CSS modules with kebab or camelCase — keep existing convention.
F. Replace any inline `style={{}}` blocks in .tsx with CSS module classes (use Webflow values).
G. Add SEO meta tags via Next.js Metadata API at top of page.tsx (title, description, OG image — use Webflow's `<head>` content as reference).
H. Verify all images use next/image with proper width/height/sizes/alt.
I. Test: `pnpm build` must pass 0 errors.

PRICING-SPECIFIC NOTES:
- Reuses PricingSection from homepage (import from @/components/home/pricing-section)
- Has additional Custom Plan CTA + ROI Calculator (per CLAUDE.md)
- ROI Calculator: presets (Startup/Growth/Enterprise), sliders, animated counters
- Verify Calendly link "Schedule a custom call" → /book-a-demo

OUR-WORKS-SPECIFIC NOTES:
- Hero with 4 trust badges
- Filter header bar: search + active filter tags (horizontal, above grid)
- Sidebar (305px fixed) + 2-col card grid (1fr 1fr)
- Cards: image-only (title/tags hidden), white bg, 20px radius, category badge top-left, eye icon bottom-right
- Image heights: 280px default, 400px at >=1280px, 450px at >=1440px
- Click card → popup modal (iframe for detail pages, image gallery for others)
- Pagination: 8 items/page, numbered buttons (44px, #1a3a6e active)
- Categories: Shopify, WordPress (active) + 5 Coming Soon (disabled)
- Portfolio data from `CMS Data/Boldteq - Our Works - *.csv` (21 items) — if local has constants file using this, verify all 21 entries present

CONSTRAINTS:
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- No `@ts-ignore`
- No `console.log` in production code
- Use latest Next.js 16 patterns (App Router, Server Components default, "use client" only when needed)
- Mobile-first responsive
- All images = next/image with priority for above-fold
- All forms = Zod-validated client-side + server action
- No Vercel/Stripe/Prisma/NextAuth (Stack A locked: Next 16 + Supabase + Railway per CLAUDE.md)

OUTPUT: 1-line summary per page describing what was fixed/added/removed. Build result.
